title: Required Voice Level at Distance
description: Distance and perception of voice. Calculates required voice level at various distances based on the inverse square law (6 dB decrease per distance doubling).

components.content:
## Voice Level Classifications

- **Normal Voice**: ~70 dB PSIL at 1 ft (0.3 m)
- **Raised Voice**: ~76 dB PSIL at 1 ft (0.3 m)
- **Very Loud Voice**: ~82 dB PSIL at 1 ft (0.3 m)
- **Shouting Voice**: ~88 dB PSIL at 1 ft (0.3 m)

## Key Principle

For every doubling of distance from the noise source, the sound pressure level decreases by 6 decibels (inverse square law).

## Background Noise Guidelines

- **Social Settings (1-4 m)**: Background noise should not exceed 55-60 dBA
- **Outdoor Recreation (5-10 m)**: Background noise should not exceed 45-55 dBA

## PSIL Formula

**PSIL** (Preferred Speech Interference Level) = 1/3 (Lp500 + Lp1000 + Lp2000)

Or from dBA: **PSIL = Lp (dBA) - 7**
